description: This source file defines a REST API resource for executing periodic accrual accounting operations in the FineGran architecture. It includes the endpoint '/v1/runaccruals' that triggers accrual calculations based on provided requests, utilizing Swagger annotations for API documentation and dependency injection for service interactions.

classes.name: AccrualAccountingApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class for triggering periodic accrual accounting actions via the API.

methods.name: executePeriodicAccrualAccounting
methods.description: Handles POST requests to initiate accrual accounting processes, serializes the request, builds a command wrapper, and logs the command for processing.
